0022600138.text: The Rockets, 4-0 and first in the Southwest, come in on a four-game winning streak with a 2-0 road record, looking to make it five straight wins as the 5th game of their season. The Bucks are 1-3, fifth in the Central and 2.5 games back, and they are 12th in the East. Houston will be without Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), both listed as out.
